scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.db:reset: node scripts/supabase.mjs db reset && pnpm db:seed
scripts.db:types: node scripts/supabase.mjs gen types typescript --local --schema public > packages/db/src/types.gen.ts
scripts.db:test: node scripts/availability-vectors.mjs && node scripts/supabase.mjs test db
scripts.db:lint: node scripts/supabase.mjs db lint --schema public,private --level warning --fail-on warning
scripts.lighthouse: node scripts/lighthouse-warm.mjs && lhci collect && node scripts/lighthouse-scores.mjs && lhci upload && lhci assert
scripts.load: node scripts/load-fixtures.mjs && k6 run load/reads.js && k6 run load/booking.js && node scripts/load-clean.mjs
